sourceCoverage.rationale: Nine separately timed source moments and article sections map to nine claims; the public aid was checked without certification of original audio.

supportingArgument.rationale: Versioned factory definitions, retained traces and task replay are documented as the speaker’s proposed or demonstrated process, not verified outcomes.

evidenceRoles.rationale: The first-party Warp demonstration, third-party timed-text aid, model judge output and GhostMesh editorial assessment are distinguished explicitly.

counterargument.rationale: An LLM judge may reward changes that satisfy its own rubric without improving delivered software, even if internal scores rise.

tradeoffs.rationale: Factory engineering can remove repeated failure causes but can itself consume more effort, operating cost and human attention than the benefits justify.

falsifiability.rationale: Matched representative tasks, blinded product acceptance, actual defects, review time, compute cost and rollback results could test claimed factory improvement.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The assessment identifies independent evaluation as the limiting factor of self-improvement, rather than treating agent count or orchestration complexity as maturity.

performance.rationale: Historical-task cost/quality points in the vendor demonstration are not independently reproduced and do not certify production cycle-time gains.

economics.rationale: A bounded experiment should compare marginal operating improvement and total human and compute effort; the source does not establish a return on investment.

threatGovernance.rationale: Approval remains with the owner for consequential changes, with source limits and privacy boundaries maintained; automated scoring is not a release authority.

ownerDecision.approval: Tony approved the Reader #57 manuscript and three Reader connections, then explicitly agreed to the source-first opening correction and to replacing the overused Demo Debt comparison with The Code Is No Longer the Hard Part. This records editorial decisions only; no production merge approval is implied.

gaps.rationale: The public transcript is a normalized third-party timestamped aid, not independently listening- or screen-certified; original YouTube subtitle retrieval was blocked.
Vendor demonstration benchmark values and claimed improvement outcomes were not independently replicated or audited.
Independent editorial review did not cover browser UAT, native iPhone accessibility behavior, deployment binding, or production release.

decisionRationale: The independent reviewer previously held and corrected an inaccurate budget cue to 18:50, then independently accepted the owner-approved opening and SharePlane comparison delta at the revised exact HTML hash. Manuscript completeness, claims, privacy and relationship roles pass scoped editorial review; preview/mobile and production authority remain separate.
